question: What is due on SYN-04 before 2026-10-03, and why?
answer:
The following items are due on SYN-04 before 2026-10-03:

1. **Battery pack BAT-04B**: It passed its 24-calendar-month life limit on 2026-03-31. This is based on EASA MoC to OSO #3 (19 Dec 2024), which states that 300 cycles / 24 months are editable defaults.

2. **Battery pack BAT-04A**: It is 6 cycles past its 300-cycle life limit. This is also based on EASA MoC to OSO #3 (19 Dec 2024), with the same editable defaults mentioned.

Hours and cycles items cannot be predicted because they advance only with flight; only calendar limits have a date.
